objectives_fil: Ihambing ang dalawang card at tukuyin ang kailangan pang kumpirmahin bago ang anumang paggamit.
objectives_en: Compare two cards and identify what needs confirmation before any use.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kaso: dalawang halaman sa bakuran ang tinatawag na “tsaang gubat”
sections.takeaway_en: Case: two yard plants are both called “tsaang gubat”

sections.takeaway_fil: Ihambing ang dalawang card at tukuyin ang kailangan pang kumpirmahin bago ang anumang paggamit.
sections.takeaway_en: Compare two cards and identify what needs confirmation before any use.

sections.takeaway_fil: Magsimula sa botanical name at bahagi sa current card.
sections.takeaway_en: Start from the botanical name and part on a current card.

check.prompt_fil: Alin ang unang ligtas na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: What is the first safe step?

options.fil: Piliin ang halamang laging ginagamit ng pamilya ng residente.
options.en: Choose the plant the resident’s family has always used.

options.fil: Basahin ang botanical name at bahagi sa current card.
options.en: Read the botanical name and part on a current card.

options.fil: Piliin ang halamang pinakakamukha ng larawan.
options.en: Pick the plant that looks most like the picture.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Iginagalang ang gamit ng pamilya, pero hindi nito ipinapakita kung aling halaman ang nasa card. 2: Ang current card na may botanical name ang tamang simula. 3: Hindi sapat na patunay ng identity ang larawan.
check.feedback_en: 1: Family use is respected, but it does not show which plant is on the card. 2: A current card with the botanical name is the proper start. 3: A picture alone does not establish identity.

sections.takeaway_fil: Dalawang halaman, iisang pangalan: ang card, hindi ang pangalan, ang batayan.
sections.takeaway_en: Two plants, one name: the card, not the name, guides the check.

sections.takeaway_fil: Hindi patunay ng identity o kaligtasan ang pangalan, larawan o “natural” na label.
sections.takeaway_en: A name, picture or “natural” label is not proof of identity or safety.

sections.takeaway_fil: Pagkatapos ng card check, itanong ang sintomas at gamot; iugnay sa clinician.
sections.takeaway_en: After the card check, ask about symptoms and medicines; consult a clinician.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang kasunod ng pag-check ng card?

options.fil: Sabihing gamitin ang halamang tugma ang pangalan.
options.en: Tell the resident to use the plant whose name matches.

options.fil: Ibigay ang dose ng lumang manual para sa tsaang gubat.
options.en: Give the old manual’s dose for tsaang gubat.

options.fil: Itanong ang sintomas at gamot; iugnay sa clinician.
options.en: Ask about symptoms and medicines; consult a clinician.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Parehong may ganoong pangalan ang dalawa; hindi patunay ng identity ang pangalan. 2: Walang clinical o lokal na pahintulot ang lumang dose. 3: Mauuna ang clinical advice bago ang anumang paghahanda o paggamit.
check.feedback_en: 1: Both plants share the name; a name alone does not confirm identity. 2: The old dose has no clinical or local authorization. 3: Clinical advice comes before any preparation or use.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sa Lunes, markahan kasama ang supervisor ang dapat kumpirmahin.
sections.takeaway_en: On Monday, mark with a supervisor what needs confirmation.
